content.comment_body: Hello members, is there a way to read the [product_name] supply voltage? My systems often use solar power, making battery voltage important. I currently use resistors with an analog input to track incoming voltage, which feels untidy and uses up an input. Is there a function block available for system voltage measurement?
It seems there is currently no dedicated function block for measuring system voltage.
What is the official process to request a new feature from the [product_name] development team? I believe this capability would benefit many users.

Reportedly, the [product_name] development team monitors topics in their conference section. You can start a topic called "My wishes for the next [product_name]" if it hasn't been created yet. Alternatively, you can contact your local [company_name] office to relay your feedback to the development team.

analysis.insight_summary: A user highlights the need for a built-in way to monitor supply voltage within the [product_name] system, particularly for solar installations. The workaround—using a resistor divider with an analog input—is inefficient and untidy. Currently, there is no dedicated solution for this, and the method of submitting feature requests is unclear.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking an easy, integrated method within [product_name] to monitor its supply voltage, without utilizing existing analog inputs.
